satisfaction_key.S+: Operators publicly attach their name and a building
satisfaction_key.S: Generally positive, thin public review corpus
satisfaction_key.n/a: Too little public review volume to grade

candidates.name: Rookie Redeveloper
candidates.price_note: Not public. Waitlist, doors twice a year. Estimated mid-ticket band by category comps.
candidates.satisfaction_note: Named student projects (Loom, Dechiro, Marco Polo, Piccolo, Grappolo, Carini, La Vita) plus public Instagram math. Review volume still small.
candidates.biddeed_take: Best transfer proof in the set: named buildings, named students, public math. The first real stop for a flipper stepping into small-town ground-up. Price opacity is the only real ding.

candidates.name: The Bright Build / Multifamily Masterclass
candidates.satisfaction_note: Named peers with companies on testimonials (Ridgeview, Oak Investment). Small public review set.
candidates.biddeed_take: Best status proof and the cleanest offer in the set. Writing-led brand for buyers who already speak development. Less useful to a first duplex buyer.

candidates.name: Cashflow Developer Academy
candidates.price_note: $3,700 launch / $6,000 list, or 2 x $1,950. $700/yr renewal after 12 months. Software Premium $49/mo or $397/yr, Pro $99/mo or $897/yr.
candidates.satisfaction_note: Software fans on YouTube; CDA public reviews thin; no named student certificates of occupancy on the launch page.
candidates.biddeed_take: Useful after you control a lot and want to build BTR. Best process content plus a software moat and the fairest mid-ticket price here. Not a substitute for a SIGNAL$ max bid.

candidates.name: ADU academies (MDM, Backyard, ADU Specialist)
candidates.price_note: Low-to-mid; often local CE, one-day academy or subscription.
candidates.biddeed_take: Highest local utility for exactly one product type. The easiest first project for an auction buyer with a small lot. Too narrow to be the whole school.

candidates.name: BiggerPockets
candidates.satisfaction_note: Trustpilot ~2.4 on a small sample of billing complaints; the free education utility itself rates high among investors.
candidates.biddeed_take: Best price and utility in the set, near-zero development coaching. Use it as a library, not a mentor.

candidates.name: University exec ed (Drexel NextGen, Harvard GSD, NYU Schack)
candidates.price_note: Harvard GSD ~$2,150; Drexel NextGen $3,000; NYU certificate ~$4,788.
candidates.biddeed_take: Honest education with a credential at the end, weak operator network. Buy it for the resume line, not for deal flow.

candidates.name: SubTo
candidates.satisfaction_note: Loud community evangelists; independent reviewers flag complexity, not-typical results and high ticket. Adjacent Trustpilot properties mixed.
candidates.biddeed_take: The biggest marketing machine in the niche, aimed at creative finance, not construction. Wrong category and 2-5x the price for someone who wants to build.

candidates.name: REDI
candidates.satisfaction_note: Real history, opaque price, decades-old claims.
candidates.biddeed_take: Six-month 1:1 sweat-equity JV model from another era. Opaque pricing, phone close. Historical interest more than a buying option.

candidates.name: FortuneBuilders
candidates.price_note: $197-997 workshop funnel into ~$10k-50k Mastery; REIvault SaaS extra.
candidates.satisfaction_note: Official Trustpilot closer to 2.8/5 across ~940 reviews with collections and upsell complaints. Polarized Reddit/BiggerPockets threads.

platforms.name: Direct mail / TV heritage + paid search

candidates.biddeed_take: A high-ticket seminar machine, not a development school. Highest complaint load and the worst fit for an auction operator in this comparison.
